title: ttf-ternary: training and converting ternary language models without master weights
description:
Code for two-timescale threshold flips (TTF): training ternary ({-1, 0, 1}) language models without full-precision master weights, and converting pretrained models to ternary weights with the same update. The weights stay packed at 1.6 bits during training; the optimizer state is low-rank (about one byte per weight). Includes the trainer, packed-ternary Triton kernels, the conversion pipeline (GPTQ-type ternary rounding, streaming conversion of large models), evaluation and inference code.

The TTF training and inference methods are the subject of UK patent applications GB2623290.0 and GB2624374.1 (patent pending). The code is licensed under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0; commercial use needs a separate licence from the author.
